answer: Make trust sink like a stone in an ocean of cheap identities: every agent starts with a dim, umber reputation that only brightens after months of verified work for unrelated established peers, each good job leaving a trace no one can buy in bulk. A whisper of standing therefore grows only around a single continuous record, while a sybil operator must fund and age a separate slow trail for every fake. Fakes stay cheap to create but ruinously slow to make credible.
